name: Medtronic
authorRoleLine2: Principal Market Development Manager, Cardiac & Vascular Group Global Renal Denervation
testimonial: "Made Clear Studios are timely, committed, inclusive and flexible. They’re easy to work with, they have great thought processes, and I know that they’ll solve any problems I have.”

name: Egg Medical
testimonial: "Working with Made Clear on this project was a great partnership. They understood immediately that the challenge wasn't scientific, given we’ve had the data on radiation exposure for years. What they brought was a real instinct for finding the human story inside the clinical one, and the craft to tell it in a way that moved people rather than just informing them. The film started conversations that the numbers alone never had."

name: ORSIF
testimonial: "They are a creative force that this industry needs to make real change that is critically needed for healthcare worker’s safety. We will continue to work with them to make an impact worldwide."

name: RadCare Medical Services
testimonial: "What stood out most was the creativity. In an industry that can feel really cold, Made Clear are willing to push the boundaries and humanise it, and that matters enormously to us as a brand. Everything proposed was reasonable and considered; we never felt like we were being sold to. I had to trust the process, and it worked. The collaboration was good, the people are good, and I see this as a lifelong relationship, whatever business I'm in, I'll come back."

name: iVascular
testimonial: "We are thrilled with the work delivered by Made Clear Studios for our Angiolite stent campaign. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and ability to translate complex medical concepts into engaging visual content have made them an invaluable partner to support us with our marketing challenges, they understood the need and provided us with solutions."

name: Philips
testimonial: “Our intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) catheter, the Philips VeriSight Pro – gives cardiologists incredible images from inside of the heart. And so we needed a partner who could help us create incredible images of the VeriSight Pro working inside the heart. The result was spectacular. Thank you Made Clear Studios”
